learning_objective: 🎯 To discover the amazing variety of plants and animals around us and understand how scientists group them to make studying nature easier!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Look around a garden! You will see tiny ants, colourful butterflies, tall trees, and soft grass. This huge, beautiful variety of living things on Earth is called diversity.
Imagine finding a book in a messy room! It is hard, right? Scientists sort plants and animals into groups based on their similarities, just like organizing a library. This is called classification.
Every living thing has a favourite place to live, like a fish in water or a camel in the desert. This natural home that provides food, water, and shelter is called a habitat.

fun_activity.title: 🌿 The Leaf Sorting Game
fun_activity.instructions: Collect 5 different fallen leaves from your neighborhood. Group them by their shape, size, or color, and write down how they are similar and different!

quick_recap: ⭐ The living world is filled with a huge variety of plants, animals, and tiny organisms.
⭐ Scientists group living things to make them easier to study and understand.
⭐ A habitat is a special natural home where an organism lives and grows.
